description: GGUF container lane: llama.cpp-native serving, plus vLLM via the in-tree (<=0.19) or vllm-gguf-plugin (>=0.23) GGUF path. One container, one kernel family: only ggml tensor types are expressible, so the non-GGUF quantized formats are structurally unavailable rather than policy-denied.

format_rules.detail: GGUF artifacts can only carry ggml tensor types; K-quants Q2_K..Q6_K + Q8_0 have CUDA MMQ/MMVQ/fused-MoE kernels in both llama.cpp and the vLLM GGUF path, BF16 is the unquantized passthrough (written as BF16/F16 tensor). The IQ family (IQ2_XXS 2.06 .. IQ4_NL 4.5 bpw) is decoded by llama.cpp and the vLLM GGUF path; its prefill uses MMVQ/Triton (no CUDA MMQ), so it stays a research/candidate rung until it clears a serving perf gate, but it is allowed here so the allocator can reach the sub-Q2_K regime.

shape_rules.detail: GGUF k-quants and 256-superblock IQ types pack 256-element superblocks along the input dim
Q8_0 and IQ4_NL pack 32-element blocks along the input dim; IQ4_NL is the only IQ rung usable when in_features % 256 != 0
